species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 20–32 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Northeast wind at 18 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
